scientific_integrity: The claim concerns the explicitly defined discrete Dirichlet operator and fixed-site near-critical asymptotics. Existing Green-function and bound-state existence formulas are acknowledged. Numerical quadrature is corroborative, not proof; no independent audit or priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Neither uniformity in defect depth nor fractional/nonlinear potentials nor continuum extrapolation is proved. Closely related full-plane and continuum threshold results create residual literature-priority risk.
title: A logarithmic edge resonance versus a linear corner threshold for square-lattice point defects
